dashboard.label: Darkmoon — Setup & Help
dashboard.description: How to feed Darkmoon events into Splunk and how the "Send to Darkmoon" alert action is secured.

ol.li: Settings → Data inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token. Name it darkmoon, set the app context to Darkmoon Pentest, and (optionally) route to an index named darkmoon.

Point a producer at https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event:
Pro (recommended): register a Darkmoon webhook targeting the HEC URL (safe-field envelope, HMAC-signed).
Anyone: run the bundled forwarder/darkmoon-to-hec.py to poll the Darkmoon REST API / read a JSON export and push safe events.
Events land as sourcetypes darkmoon:campaign, darkmoon:finding, darkmoon:retest, darkmoon:pr — parsed and CIM-aligned by this app.

div.h2: 2. Configure the connection (for the alert action)
div.p: Run the app Set up page (Manage Apps → Darkmoon Pentest → Set up). It stores the base URL in darkmoon.conf and the API token encrypted in storage/passwords — never in a .conf file, log or dashboard.
div.h2: 3. "Send to Darkmoon" alert action — safety model

ul.li: Target allowlist: only hosts in lookups/darkmoon_targets.csv can ever be sent. Everything else is refused.
Safe-harbor: non-destructive profile enforced unless a target row explicitly opts in.
Auth: token pulled from storage/passwords at runtime via the session key.
Rate limit: token bucket (max launches/hour), hard-capped in the script.
TLS verified on the outbound call; result rows treated as untrusted (strict host/IP validation).
Dry-run ON by default — nothing is launched until you set dry_run=0.

div.p: Ingestion + dashboards work with any Darkmoon edition that can emit events. The alert action and setup call the Darkmoon Pro REST API and are Pro-only. The open-source Darkmoon CLI does not expose that API.
Privacy: events carry safe metadata only (ids, severity, status, target ref, MITRE, technology, timestamps). Evidence, secrets, credentials, tokens and request/response bodies are never ingested.
